title: Magic in the Water
description: On vacation at a beautiful lake in British Columbia, Ashley (Sarah Wayne) and Joshua (Joshua Jackson), the children of workaholic radio host Jack Black (Mark Harmon), learn about its mythical inhabitant, a sea monster named Orky. Soon, the kids learn that Orky is not only real, he's attempting to communicate with humans to warn them that an evil corporation is illegally dumping pollutants into his home. They try to save Orky with the help of an elderly Native American (Frank Sotonoma Salsedo).

title: Holly Hobbie
description: Heather decides to take a stand against her school's unfair funding.

title: The InBESTigators
description: Someone sabotages a lemonade stand; at a school fundraiser, the fortune-teller's predictions are eerily accurate.

title: Lark Rise to Candleford
description: Alf vows to bring in the harvest in record time; Daniel announces that he has taken a new job in Cambridge.

title: All-Round Champion
description: The sport is Beach Volleyball and Ariana is Sport Leader. Wil and Deliya are teammates again and must work on communicating. Michael comes back from a rough week in the canoe to dominate on the sand. Elli fights some homesickness, losing focus.

title: Leap of Faith
description: Three groups of teens with an array of spiritual, emotional, and social challenges go to three different locations to help bring sustainable change to communities in Bolivia, Vanuatu, and Mongolia, finding hope, meaning, and healing as they serve.

title: After Further Review
description: Dave McCann, David Nixon, and Blaine Fowler recap BYU's spooky 27-20 Halloween win over Arizona State, highlighting key defensive stops, sacks, passing plays and the biggest moments from a hard-fought battle.

title: BYU Football With Kalani Sitake
description: Greg Wrubell spends time with head coach Kalani Sitake and a player as they review the last game, preview the next one and take questions from fans in-person and on Twitter.

title: Live: BYU Sports Nation Game Day
description: Pregame analysis for BYU sports.

title: Art of Falling in Love
description: An artist painting a mural on a new hospital wing falls for the project's architect but worries he may not want to be with her if she reveals the unfortunate story behind her secret bucket list.

title: Random Acts
description: Kimberly always puts others first, so the hosts give her a day off that she will never forget.

title: Highway to Heaven
description: Jonathan and Mark, posing as high-school teachers, help a diverse group of students deal with the trauma of the upcoming senior prom.

title: Heartland
description: Amy must help a skeptical performer, and her pair of matched liberty horses work together again; Jack unexpectedly buys Mitch's herd of cattle; Tim returns from his trip with a surprise for everyone.

title: Heartland
description: A wild stallion escapes from Sam's ranch during a burglary and Amy will stop at nothing to find him; Lisa's latest business investment is at risk; Tim and Jessica adjust to life back at Heartland.

title: Heartland
description: Amy discovers a teen with a gift for horses at Cooper's therapy center; Lou is pressured to shut the center down over recent break-ins; Lisa has Jack install a security system with Parker's help.

title: Paddington
description: After a deadly earthquake destroys his home in Peruvian rainforest, a young bear makes his way to England in search of a new home. The bear, dubbed "Paddington" for the London train station, finds shelter with the family of Henry and Mary Brown. Although Paddington's amazement at urban living soon endears him to the Browns, someone else has her eye on him: Taxidermist Millicent Clyde has designs on the rare bear and his hide.

title: Field of Dreams
description: When Iowa farmer Ray hears a mysterious voice one night in his cornfield saying "If you build it, he will come," he feels the need to act. Despite taunts of lunacy, Ray builds a baseball diamond on his land, supported by his wife, Annie. Afterward, the ghosts of great players start emerging from the crops to play ball, led by "Shoeless" Joe Jackson. But, as Ray learns, this field of dreams is about much more than bringing former baseball greats out to play.

title: Miracle
description: When college coach Herb Brooks (Kurt Russell) is hired to helm the 1980 U.S. men's Olympic hockey team, he brings a unique and brash style to the ice. After assembling a team of hot-headed college all-stars, who are humiliated in an early match, Brooks unites his squad against a common foe, the heavily-favored Soviet team. As the U.S. squad tries to overcome insurmountable odds and win the gold medal, the team becomes a microcosm for American patriotism during the Cold War.

description: The hosts plan a surprise for Missy, a 17-year-old with spina bifida, to be a reporter for a day.

title: The Wizard of Paws
description: Derrick is in India to help Frodo, a horse who lost the use of one leg; rescued by Zoha at the Backwater Animal Sanctuary, Frodo now faces a critical moment: without a new prosthetic, he may become completely immobile.

title: Music & the Spoken Word
description: The Tabernacle Choir at Temple Square performs songs of hope, faith and inspiration; singing sacred hymns both new and old from around the world as well as uplifting selections from the American songbook.

title: Worldwide Devotional for Young Adults
description: Elder and Sister Christofferson share an inspirational message with young adults around the world.

title: Come Follow Up
description: Ben Lomu meets with Old Testament scholar Gaye Strathearn, as well as special guest Sister Camille N. Johnson, to discuss the Godly courage of Daniel and how people can trust in the Lord when their faith is tried.

title: BYU Idaho Devotional
description: A range of speakers give weekly devotionals and forums.

title: Latter-Day Profiles
description: Sports psychologist and former BYU tennis coach Dr. Craig Manning shares insights on high performance, mental strength and finding truth. Discover how applying these principles can elevate your daily faith, family and personal growth.

title: BYU Devotional Address
description: Elder Ronald A. Rasband of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. Nothing you do in your life will be more important than gaining and living your testimony of our Father in Heaven and His Son, our Lord and Savior.

title: BYU Devotional Address
description: Paul V. Johnson, Presidency of the Seventy for the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.

title: Artful
description: Jeff Hein explains his devotion to Christ; Jeanette Oren creates art to honor her family history.

title: Grace Notes
description: Winner of "The Voice" Jordan Smith performs "Be Still and Know" and "Don't Quit"; CeCe Winans performs "Believe for It" and "Great Is Thy Faithfulness.".

title: Dedicate
description: Can the relationships we build in this life last forever? The six young adults discover one of the most meaningful purposes of temples: to bind us to Jesus Christ and unite families for eternity; they learn why marriage and family are central to temple worship and how sacred promises made with God can connect husbands, wives, and families beyond this life.

title: Peter Pan
description: As Wendy Darling (Rachel Hurd-Wood) recounts stories to her brothers, John (Harry Newell) and Michael (Freddie Popplewell), she is visited by Peter Pan (Jeremy Sumpter). Peter, a boy who magically never ages, invites Wendy and her brothers to Neverland, an island where he lives with the Lost Boys. Once there, however, Wendy and her brothers are kidnapped by Captain Hook (Jason Isaacs). Peter, with assistance from the fairy Tink (Ludivine Sagnier), must face Hook in order to rescue the Darlings.
